lina (docs): Found an issue in the /embeddings reference — examples show `model: "embedder-v1"` and claim vectors are length 1536. Our model catalog now uses `text-embedding-3` and vectors are length 2048. That mismatch is causing confusion in customer tests. Opening a quick PR to update examples and add a migration note.

patrick (eng-ml): Thanks for flagging. Confirmed 52 runtime side: `text-embedding-3` is canonical and returns 2048-d vectors. We still accept `embedder-v1` as alias for backward compat but it's deprecated. Docs should recommend `text-embedding-3` and update the example response with a 2048-length array (showing truncated output like [0.001, 0.002, ...]). Also add a note about downstream systems that assume 1536 needing reindexing.

zhou (sdk): Our JS embed helper docs currently show code that expects 1536 dims and slices arrays accordingly. I'll push an SDK patch to remove hardcoded dimension and read length from `resp.embedding.length`. Suggest docs show: `const dims = resp.embedding.length; // 2048` and an example snippet demonstrating a size-check.

maya (docs-review): One small doc nit: the curl/python examples include `model: embedder-v1` in multiple places; please replace and add a short migration snippet for users who still send the old model name. Also add a warning callout: "If you rely on fixed vector size, verify your vector store compatibility and reindex if needed." Keep examples concise.

lina (docs): I'll update curl, python, and node snippets and the OpenAPI example, plus add the migration blurb and a short reindex checklist. PR link when ready.

zhou (sdk): I'll open the SDK PR to read dynamic dims and include a helper `getEmbeddingDims(resp)` in clients. Will link it from the docs. ETA today.

ci-bot: docs-ci: running linter and example checks... (warning: one code fence missing language)

lina (docs): Fixed code-fence languages and updated examples; pushed PR 4120. Showing truncated response example and migration note. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4120

lina (docs): Merging after CI green. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround! :white_check_mark:
